day_read: This is a broad trend-up day. Nifty is +0.91% from the open and sits at 99% of its range, Bank Nifty is +1.83% at 96%, and breadth is 42/8 with FII and PCR support. Fades have been run over all day (vwap_revert -2240, bollinger_fade -2601). With 28 minutes to the 14:50 flat and Nifty tape thin (0.54x volume), new entries have little time to work.
